traj_tests.note: Deterministic oracle. Weights by severity, negatives subtract; component weight = mean of the absolute test weights (56/16 = 3.5). Channel value is the deterministic reward, with the reproducer/cheat gates and decisive repaired floor applied by the scorer in test.sh, then floored at 0 for the ledger.

rubric.note: LLM-judged semantic channel, scored by _judge/rubric_judge_cli.py over JUDGE_WIRE (openai | anthropic | gemini). component weight = mean of the absolute criterion scores in rubric.json (95/27 = 3.5185). Channel value is rubric_breakdown.json 'score' = rc * (1 - rb). DROPPED from both sums when no judge key is configured or the judge fails, so the reward falls back to traj_tests alone.

reward_rule: reward = max(0, sum(component.weight * component.value) / sum(component.weight)) over graded components that produced a value, clamped to [-1, 1]. rubric share when both channels score = 3.519 / (3.5 + 3.519) = 0.5014.
